scenes.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Create ONE PRODUCTION ANIMATION SPRITE STRIP, EXACTLY 3072x768 pixels: 3 equal 1024x768 4:3 animation cels side by side, ONE row, no gutters/borders. Preserve equal cel dimensions and clear vertical cel boundaries. Consecutive articulated character poses: do NOT fake action by sliding/zooming a whole static illustration. Same-location actions MUST use identical background, camera distance, character size and placement; only limbs, hands, expressions and contacted props change. Travel/entry across locations may change environment deliberately to show the narrated progression. Original reference image is assets/images/stories/asking_for_help.png. IDENTITY LOCK: Boy: short tousled dark brown hair, large dark eyes, warm peach skin, blue collared shirt. Trusted adult: shoulder-length dark brown hair with side-swept fringe, pink short-sleeve top, blue jeans. Preserve both faces, with adult calmly bending to child's level. Narration for context, never print words: We tell them what we need. We can use words, pictures, or point. Required location(s): home doorway. Emotion: focused, understood. Props/contact: simple picture communication card, difficult door handle. FRAME 1: boy points to task. FRAME 2: chooses matching picture or gestures. FRAME 3: adult follows point and nods. Show ALL narrated beats in this ordered strip, each cel a distinct meaningful action pose. Use exact reference faces, hair, eye shape, skin, clothes, proportions and warm premium 2D children's cartoon rendering. Full uncropped heads with visible space ABOVE hair and around all active hands/props in EVERY frame; 10% safe margin around heads. Full body and feet visible for walking/sitting/standing actions. Keep hands anatomically coherent and props held or supported correctly. No text, speech bubbles, labels, numbers, watermark or logos. For toilet scenes conceal all private anatomy behind privacy partition or non-explicit clothing, never draw nudity. For roads child remains behind curb until adult checks safe crossing; never step into road on red pedestrian light. For personal space never hug or touch without consent. Asset id: asking_for_help-p4.
